entities.name: Nilanjona
entities.description: Nilanjona grew up with a fractured family and abuse from her stepmother, later discovering her destiny as the next Water Guardian and reuniting with her real mother.
entities.quote: Nilanjona’s Arc – Origin of the Water Guardian Early Life & Bonds Grew up in Saidpur with a fractured family

entities.name: Saery
entities.description: Nilanjona's loving grandmother who supported her and orchestrated a journey to lead Nilanjona to her real destiny.
entities.quote: Loved deeply by her Grandmother(Saery) (the only true supporter).

entities.name: Ethan
entities.description: A broken and bullied individual who met Nilanjona in Saidpur and dated her for a while before they drifted apart.
entities.quote: Ethan, broken and bullied after leaving Bogura and Zayn, met her in Saidpur. - She became the second person in his life

entities.name: Zayn
entities.description: An individual connected to Ethan's past before Ethan met Nilanjona.
entities.quote: Ethan, broken and bullied after leaving Bogura and Zayn, met her in Saidpur.

entities.name: Niharo
entities.description: The true mastermind behind the plot involving the stepmother, waiting for the real vessel with all elements to rise.
entities.quote: The real vessel — the one with all elements — will rise one day (hint at Niharo).
